name: Fat City Entertainment
bio: The team behind some of Kingston's busiest weeknights. Fat City runs polished, high-energy trivia and music bingo shows with pro hosting, custom rounds, and a following that travels between venues.

testimonials.quote: Our Tuesdays went from dead to booked-out tables.
testimonials.author: Bar manager

name: Mystery Mike Events
tagline: Murder mystery nights that pack the room
bio: Mike runs 60–90 minute whodunit nights where guests play themselves — no costumes, no cringe, just clues, alibis, and a room that won't stop talking about it. Ideal for pubs, breweries, and private bookings.

testimonials.quote: 47 tickets on a Tuesday. Second seating added by 8pm.
testimonials.author: Owner

name: The Laughing Loon Comedy
tagline: Hosted comedy & improv nights, zero dead air
bio: A hosted comedy format that works even without a headliner: improv games, audience rounds, and a running MC who keeps the room warm. Books standalone nights or opens for live music.

testimonials.quote: The mid-week crowd actually came back the next week.
testimonials.author: GM

name: The Tavernkeeper's Guild
bio: Turns your room into a medieval tavern for a night: personas, mini-quests, tavern games, and a Guildmaster host. No RPG knowledge needed — huge with student groups and game-store crowds.

testimonials.quote: People showed up in costume. We sold out of mead-adjacent everything.
testimonials.author: Events lead

name: Kingston Karaoke Collective
tagline: Karaoke & song-game nights with a real host
bio: Full-service karaoke with a host who runs the room — themed rounds, duet drafts, and song games between singers so the night never stalls. Own PA, lights, and library.

testimonials.quote: Best bar spend per head of any night we run.
testimonials.author: Owner
